exposure: uterine tachysystole with fetal heart rate involvement
cohort: Pregnant women at or beyond 36 weeks gestation requiring labor induction (n=354)
finding: MVI was effective and safe for labor induction, with high vaginal delivery rates but a notable risk of uterine tachysystole.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery rates were significantly different between nulliparous and parous women (59.9% vs 86.1%, p < 0.001) in women induced with misoprostol vaginal insert.
